title: 第十四章 第一次实战考核第十三章 校园角落的能量波动
lines: 第十四章：第一次实战考核
幻境学院的试炼场悬浮在斯卡市东郊的云海之上，由十六块菱形浮空石组成，边缘流淌着淡金色的结界光晕。此刻，三十名“秘境预备班”的新生正站在中央主石上，校服领口别着的银质徽章在阳光下泛着冷光——那是进入预备班的标志，也是今日实战考核的准入凭证。
林澈指尖无意识地摩挲着徽章边缘，耳边是风穿过结界的嗡鸣。他左边站着苏璃，少女正低头轻嗅手腕上缠绕的青藤，那是她用灵都国秘术催生的“感知藤”，能在战斗中预警能量波动；右边的凯则在活动筋骨，每一次握拳，指缝间都有细碎的火星迸溅，引得旁边镜幻国的几个学生频频侧目。
“都安静。”
高台上，负责实战课的穆勒导师声如洪钟。这位曾是幻灵国皇家骑士团团长的中年男人，右臂覆盖着暗金色的魔法铠甲，据说那是用“大地之心”矿石锻造的，能硬抗七阶以下的魔法攻击。
“规则很简单，”穆勒的目光扫过全场，“十六块浮空石，每块对应一个‘试炼目标’——可能是模拟傀儡，也可能是特殊环境陷阱。你们需要在一个时辰内，至少拿到三块刻有学院徽记的‘试炼令牌’。”
他顿了顿，加重语气：“记住，这不是单纯的厮杀。令牌可能藏在傀儡的核心，也可能需要破解陷阱才能获取。更重要的是——”他指向试炼场边缘闪烁的红色符文，“一旦有人触发‘危险阈值’，比如对同伴出手，或者破坏浮空石结构，考核直接终止，且本学期实战课记零分。”
人群中响起一阵低低的议论。林澈注意到，站在斜对面的几个魔法国学生正交换眼神，为首的红发少年里昂嘴角勾起一抹挑衅的笑——上周理论课上，里昂曾嘲讽林澈的“空间感知”是“废物天赋”，两人险些起冲突。
“考核开始！”
穆勒话音未落，十六块浮空石边缘的传送阵同时亮起白光。林澈只觉眼前一花，脚下的触感已从坚硬的岩石变成了湿润的泥土。
他身处的是一块被茂密丛林覆盖的浮空石，空气中弥漫着潮湿的水汽，头顶的假太阳散发着柔和的光。“感知藤”的提示？林澈下意识看向身侧，才想起传送时大家被随机分散了。
“先找令牌。”林澈深吸一口气，集中精神催动体内的魔法力。不同于元素法师能直接调动外界能量，他的“空间感知”更像一种内在的雷达，能捕捉到周围空间的细微褶皱——而承载着魔法能量的试炼令牌，必然会引起这种褶皱。
果然，在前方约五十米的一棵巨树后，他感觉到了一丝微弱却稳定的能量波动。
林澈放轻脚步，拨开及腰的草丛。巨树的树干上，挂着一块巴掌大的青铜令牌，徽记清晰可见。但就在他伸手去够的瞬间，地面突然震动起来，树根如同活物般破土而出，织成一张密不透风的网，朝着他的脚踝缠来！
“是‘缠绕傀儡’。”林澈反应极快，侧身翻滚躲开第一波攻击。他认出这是学院常用的三阶傀儡，以植物为媒介，擅长控制而非直接攻击。
傀儡的核心在哪里？林澈一边闪避不断袭来的树根，一边用空间感知扫描四周。很快，他在巨树的树洞里发现了异常——那里的空间褶皱比令牌处更强烈，且带着明显的“敌意”波动。
“找到了。”林澈眼神一凝，猛地冲向树洞。树根如蛇般追来，眼看就要缠住他的小腿，他突然矮身，双手在身前划出一个菱形印记。
“空间折叠·短距跳跃！”
这是他最近刚掌握的技巧，能在五米范围内进行瞬间移动。白光闪过，林澈的身影出现在树洞前，不等傀儡反应，他一拳砸向树洞深处——那里果然藏着一块拳头大小的水晶核心。
“咔嚓”一声，水晶碎裂。缠绕的树根瞬间失去力气，瘫软在地。林澈摘下树干上的令牌，塞进腰间的布袋，刚松了口气，就听到不远处传来一声清脆的爆炸声。
是凯的火焰魔法！
林澈立刻朝着声音来源跑去，空间感知告诉他，那里的能量波动极其剧烈，甚至夹杂着一丝……苏璃的治愈魔法气息。
穿过一片灌木丛，他看到了惊人的一幕：凯正被三个手持长矛的“铁卫傀儡”围攻，他周身燃烧着半米高的火焰，却显得有些狼狈——左臂的校服被划破，渗出血迹。而在他身后，苏璃正蹲在地上，双手按在一名受伤的镜幻国女生胸前，青绿色的治愈光芒包裹着伤口，但她的额头已布满冷汗。
“林澈！”凯看到他，眼睛一亮，随即怒吼一声，“别管我们，先解决左边那个傀儡的核心！”
林澈瞬间明白。铁卫傀儡是五阶防御型傀儡，核心藏在胸口的铠甲里，普通攻击难以击破。但它们的动作相对迟缓，且有明显的攻击盲区。
“苏璃，能牵制住右边两个吗？”林澈喊道。
苏璃抬头，脸上沾着泥土，却眼神坚定：“可以！”她猛地拍向地面，数根粗壮的藤蔓破土而出，如同锁链般缠向右侧的两个铁卫傀儡。但傀儡的长矛带着破风之势，瞬间将藤蔓斩断了一半。
“就是现在！”
林澈抓住傀儡攻击的间隙，再次发动短距跳跃，闪到左侧铁卫的身后。他没有直接攻击铠甲，而是将魔法力凝聚在指尖，猛地刺入傀儡关节处的缝隙——那里是铠甲连接最薄弱的地方。
“滋啦！”
空间能量瞬间爆发，傀儡的关节处冒出黑烟，动作明显迟滞。凯抓住机会，凝聚全身力量，将一团篮球大小的火球狠狠砸向傀儡胸口。

Chapter 14: The first practical assessment
The training ground of the Academy of Illusions is suspended above the sea of clouds on the eastern outskirts of Ska City. It is composed of sixteen diamond-shaped floating stones, with a pale golden barrier halo flowing around the edges. At this moment, thirty freshmen from the "Secret Realm Preparatory Class" are standing on the main stone in the center. The silver badges pinned to the collars of their school uniforms are glowing coldly in the sun - that is the symbol of entering the preparatory class and the admission certificate for today's actual combat assessment.
Lin Che's fingertips unconsciously rubbed the edge of the badge, and her ears could hear the hum of the wind passing through the barrier. Su Li stood on his left. The girl was lowering her head and sniffing the ivy wrapped around her wrist. It was the "sensing vine" she created with the secret technique of Lingdu Kingdom, which could warn of energy fluctuations in battle. Kai on the right was moving his muscles. Every time he made a fist, tiny sparks flew between his fingers, attracting several students from Jinghuan Kingdom next to him.
"All quiet."
On the high platform, the voice of instructor Muller, who is in charge of practical classes, is like a bell. This middle-aged man, who was once the leader of the Royal Knights of the Phantom Kingdom, has a dark golden magic armor covering his right arm. It is said that it was forged from the "Heart of the Earth" ore and can withstand magic attacks of levels below seven.
"The rules are very simple," Mueller's gaze swept across the audience. "Sixteen floating stones, each corresponding to a 'trial target' - it may be a simulated puppet, or it may be a special environment trap. You need to get at least three 'trial tokens' engraved with the college emblem within an hour."
He paused and emphasized: "Remember, this is not a simple fight. The token may be hidden in the core of the puppet, or you may need to break a trap to obtain it. More importantly -" he pointed to the flashing red runes on the edge of the trial field, "Once someone triggers the 'danger threshold', such as attacking a companion, or destroying the floating stone structure, the assessment will be terminated directly, and the actual combat class for this semester will be recorded with zero points."
There was a low murmur among the crowd. Lin Che noticed that several students from the Magic Kingdom standing diagonally opposite were exchanging glances. The red-haired boy in charge, Leon, had a provocative smile on his lips. In the theory class last week, Leon had ridiculed Lin Che's "spatial perception" as a "waste talent", and the two almost had a conflict.
"The assessment begins!"
Before Mueller finished speaking, the teleportation array on the edge of the sixteen floating stones lit up with white light at the same time. Lin Che's eyes blurred as the feeling under her feet changed from hard rock to moist soil.
He was on a floating rock covered by dense jungle. The air was filled with humid water vapor, and the fake sun above his head was emitting soft light. Tips for “perception vine”? Lin Che subconsciously looked to her side and then remembered that everyone was randomly scattered during the teleportation.
"Find the token first." Lin Che took a deep breath and concentrated on activating the magic power in her body. Unlike an elemental mage who can directly mobilize external energy, his "space perception" is more like an internal radar that can capture the subtle wrinkles in the surrounding space - and the trial token carrying magical energy will inevitably cause such wrinkles.
Sure enough, behind a giant tree about fifty meters ahead, he felt a faint but stable energy fluctuation.
Lin Che stepped lightly and pushed aside the grass reaching her waist. On the trunk of the giant tree, there is a palm-sized bronze token hanging, and the emblem is clearly visible. But the moment he reached for it, the ground suddenly shook, and tree roots burst out of the ground like living creatures, weaving into an airtight net and wrapping around his ankles!
"It's the 'entangling puppet'." Lin Che reacted very quickly and rolled sideways to avoid the first wave of attacks. He recognized that this was a third-level puppet commonly used in the academy. It used plants as a medium and was good at control rather than direct attack.
Where is the core of the puppet? Lin Che used her spatial perception to scan her surroundings while dodging the incoming tree roots. Soon, he discovered an anomaly in the hollow of the giant tree - the spatial folds there were stronger than those at the token, with obvious "hostile" fluctuations.
"Found it." Lin Che's eyes narrowed and she rushed towards the tree hole. The tree roots were chasing after him like snakes and were about to wrap around his calves. He suddenly dwarfed and drew a diamond-shaped mark in front of him with his hands.
"Space folding·short jump!"
This is a skill he has recently mastered, which allows him to teleport within a range of five meters. White light flashed, and Lin Che's figure appeared in front of the tree hole. Without waiting for the puppet to react, he punched the depths of the tree hole - there was indeed a fist-sized crystal core hidden there.
There was a "click" and the crystal shattered. The entangled tree roots instantly lost their strength and collapsed to the ground. Lin Che took off the token from the tree trunk and stuffed it into the cloth bag at her waist. Just as she breathed a sigh of relief, she heard a crisp explosion not far away.
It's Kai's fire magic!
Lin Che immediately ran towards the source of the sound. His spatial perception told him that the energy fluctuations there were extremely violent, and there was even a hint of... Su Li's healing magic aura.
Passing through a bush, he saw an astonishing scene: Kai was being besieged by three "Iron Guard puppets" holding spears. Half a meter of flames were burning around him, but he looked a little embarrassed - the school uniform on his left arm was scratched and blood oozing out. Behind him, Su Li was squatting on the ground, pressing her hands on the chest of an injured girl from Jing Huan Kingdom. The green healing light wrapped the wound, but her forehead was already covered with cold sweat.
"Lin Che!" Kai's eyes lit up when he saw him, and he roared angrily, "Leave us alone and deal with the core of the puppet on the left first!"
Lin Che understood instantly. The Iron Guard Puppet is a fifth-level defensive puppet. Its core is hidden in the armor on its chest and is difficult to break through with ordinary attacks. However, their movements are relatively slow and they have obvious attack blind spots.
"Su Li, can you contain the two on the right?" Lin Che shouted.
